products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4 · V4
products.summary: 480×480 触控RGB屏，16MiB Flash / 8MiB PSRAM；按精确SKU提供数字子集与有来源的部分机械模型。
limitations: 数字协议、真实固件输出、模型来源与实机验收分别记录；全部镜像保持trial，未完成原厂应用全流程或浏览器WebGL验收。
CAN/TWAI、RS485对端、USB、无线、模拟供电/充电、隔离输入输出电压及蜂鸣器声音未实现。
带TF卡槽默认准备64MiB FAT32；客体挂载依赖本板真实总线实现，不把镜像准备当作读写证明。

Manufacturer CAD retains original millimetres, source transforms, solids and open shells; no enclosure or invisible circuitry invented. Unversioned CAD is a mechanical family reference, not proof of current electrical revision or complete physical BOM.

Physical optical area is labelled VA, not independently measured active pixel area. The live framebuffer fits inside VA with square digital pixels; no calibrated pixel pitch, viewing angle, glass refraction, brightness or colour claim.

BOOT interaction follows the sourced button. RESET, analog battery latch, USB and terminal geometry remain visual where not implemented; connector mating depth and exact line sequence are not certified.

Exact official assembly was found in the Chinese resource page; it is unversioned and does not establish currentV4 CH32 component identity or placement. The runtime separately follows the pinnedV4 electrical schematic.
Touch glass84.2 square; native source includes separate LCD/FPC and all documented physical pieces.
V4使用CH32V003而非旧TCA9554；EX2为GT911中断，GPIO16属于SYS_OUT电源控制网，未暴露普通GPIO电源键。旧原理图另存，未混用版本。
两个官方FactoryOnly恢复镜像的触控/非触控身份由固定README区分；完整应用兼容性仍未验证。
两份原厂V4镜像各运行5秒并返回app_main：触控236个RGB帧、非触控239帧且实际挂载/卸载FAT32（28条SD命令、2次超时、读取1616字节）；两者均未写CH32 PWM，背光初态未知，保留黑屏，未证实可见原厂界面。证据：docs/evidence/waveshare-touch4-v4-runtime-2026-11-24。

chronology.notes: 未从资料日期、SKU序号或抓取时间推算硬件上市日。
